description:
Access the Protein Data Bank (RCSB PDB) for macromolecular structure data.

  SEARCH: Provide "query" to find structures (e.g., "kinase inhibitor", "hemoglobin").
  GET: Provide "pdb_id" to retrieve entry metadata with optional detail sections. Sections list per-entity records (polymer_entities, ligands, assembly); when some records fail while siblings succeed, each failure appears as an inline {_error} item AND the response carries a top-level "warnings" array naming the section and failed item.
  DOWNLOAD: Provide "pdb_id" + download=true to save the structure file and get the file path.

download.description: Save the structure file to disk and return the file path. Only used with pdb_id.

format.description: File format: "cif" (mmCIF, recommended, always available) or "pdb" (legacy format, may not exist for some entries). Only used with download=true.

query.description: Free-text search query to find PDB entries. Omit pdb_id when searching.

sections.description: Metadata sections: polymer_entities (chains and sequences), ligands (small molecules and ions), assembly (biological assembly), experiment (method, resolution), citation (publication). Use "all" for everything. Default: core summary only.

name: pdb
